title: France ramps up judicial action to prevent forest fires

title: Trump claims Hamas disarmament plan reached by Board of Peace
subhead: US President Donald Trump says his Board of Peace has reached an agreement for the 'complete disarmament' of Hamas, which the militant group has confirmed, with Israel yet to comment.

title: North Africa, an increasingly uneasy hideout for French 'narcos'
subhead: 'Africa under the influence' (3/6). In Morocco, Algeria and Tunisia, traffickers long believed they were untouchable. But Paris's new relationships with Rabat and Algiers have changed the rules, forcing criminals to look for new destinations.

title: Joëlle Zask, philosopher: 'When it comes to megafires, political will at the highest level depends on the will of the citizen majority'
subhead: Extreme wildfires are a security threat that calls for a new social contract, according to the university professor. In an opinion piece for Le Monde, she advocates for an approach that combines prevention, environmentalism and solidarity.
